summary: Cedar runtime evaluator adapter and backbone write-policy conformance pack for implemented messenger, mail, social, and community write actions.
claim_boundary: In-process Cedar evaluator/conformance only. This slice maps AuthzRequest values into PolicySet authorization decisions, deterministic decision refs, and append-only evaluation log entries. It does not deploy a Cedar PDP service, bind Envoy/ext_authz, enforce at a live gateway, or claim production policy latency/SLO evidence.

facets.F1_simplicity: The evaluator reuses the existing policy-cedar domain PolicySet instead of adding another policy language or runtime dependency.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Backbone write actions now have a tenant-scoped policy pack, explicit-deny precedence tests, default-deny tests, and auditable decision refs before cloud gateway integration.
facets.F3_adversarial: Conformance tests cover allow for every implemented write operation, wrong-tenant default deny, explicit deny override, log filtering, missing audit refusal, and invalid role context refusal.
facets.F5_quality: Focused Cedar tests plus broad backbone cargo check/test/clippy/fmt, CI matrix validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Policy evaluation requires tenant scope, audit correlation, principal roles, action/resource matching, and backbone data-plane context. It fails closed on missing allow.
facets.F11_observability: Every evaluation emits a deterministic decision ref and append-only log entry carrying tenant, principal, action, resource, effect, determining policies, and audit correlation ID. Runtime OpenTelemetry emission remains pending.
